title: Moving & Relocation Hour-of-Day Activity Heatmap
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=box:inventory
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day most moving events typically arrive.
value: Hour-of-day patterns expose automation schedules, commute windows, and habits that are easy to miss in daily totals alone.
implementation: Ingest `box:inventory` with accurate `_time` values and chart hourly counts to see when the feed is naturally busy or quiet.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of event count by hour of day.
grandmaExplanation: It notices what time of day your moving data is usually busiest so you can spot routines that moved or feeds that went quiet at the wrong hour.
